api.error.network.defaultMessage: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
api.error.network.description: Error message when a request to the server got no answer (offline, or the server is down).

api.error.status.defaultMessage: The server could not handle the request (error {status}). Try again later.
api.error.status.description: Error message when the server failed without describing the problem. {status} is the HTTP status code, for example 502.

compose.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the new-post sheet. The draft is kept.

compose.failed.description: Error after publishing a post failed. The draft is kept. {reason} is the error message.

compose.language.label.description: Label of the choice of the language a post is written in.

compose.language.und.description: Choice of post language when the user does not say which language the post is in.

compose.media.add.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach images to a post.

compose.media.description.hint.defaultMessage: Describe the image for people who cannot see it.
compose.media.description.hint.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image.

compose.media.description.label.description: Label of the alternative text field of an attached image. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.description.required.defaultMessage: Describe the image for people who cannot see it. Your settings ask for a description of every image.
compose.media.description.required.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image when the user's settings ask for a description of every image.

compose.media.failed.description: State of an attached image whose upload failed. {reason} is the error message.

compose.media.failed_processing.defaultMessage: The server could not process this image.
compose.media.failed_processing.description: Why an attached image failed: the server could not process it.

compose.media.hint.defaultMessage: Up to {max, plural, other {# images}}: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP. Location and other metadata are removed before upload.
compose.media.hint.description: Help text next to the button that attaches images. {max} is the most images a post can have.

compose.media.list.description: Accessible name of the list of images attached to the post being written.

compose.media.processing.description: State of an attached image while the server prepares it.

compose.media.remove.description: Button that removes an attached image from the post. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.too_many.defaultMessage: A post can have at most {max, plural, other {# images}}. The rest were not added.
compose.media.too_many.description: Notice when the user picked more images than a post can have. {max} is the most images a post can have.

compose.media.unsupported.defaultMessage: {name} is not a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image.
compose.media.unsupported.description: Notice when a picked file is not an image type the server accepts. {name} is the file name.

compose.media.uploading.description: State of an attached image while it is being sent to the server.

compose.missing_description.add.description: Button of the confirmation that goes back to the form to describe the images.

compose.missing_description.body.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# image has no description.} other {# images have no description.}} People who cannot see the images will not know what they show.
compose.missing_description.body.description: Text of the confirmation about images without a description. {count} is how many images have none.

compose.missing_description.post.description: Button of the confirmation that posts without the descriptions.

compose.missing_description.title.description: Title of the confirmation shown when attached images have no description and the user's settings ask for one.

compose.open.description: Floating button on phones and tablets that opens the form for a new post.

compose.outbox.discard.description: Button that throws away a post that could not be sent.

compose.outbox.edit.description: Button that puts a post that could not be sent back into the form.

compose.outbox.failed.description: State of a post that could not be sent. {reason} is the error message.

compose.outbox.label.description: Accessible name of the list of posts that are being sent or could not be sent.

compose.outbox.retry.description: Button that sends a post that could not be sent again.

compose.outbox.sending.description: State of a post that is being sent.

compose.outbox.unsent.description: State of a post whose sending was interrupted (for example by reloading the page).

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
compose.over.description: Counter under a text field when the text is longer than allowed. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.posted.description: Notice after a post was published.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
compose.remaining.description: Counter under a text field: how many more characters fit. {count} is a number.

compose.reply.cancel.description: Button that turns the reply being written into a normal post.

compose.reply.label.description: Above the new-post form: the post being replied to. {name} is the author's display name or handle.

compose.reply.unavailable.defaultMessage: The post you are replying to cannot be shown.
compose.reply.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the post being replied to when it could not be loaded.

compose.sensitive.defaultMessage: Hide the images until readers show them
compose.sensitive.description: Checkbox that marks the attached images as sensitive.

compose.submit.description: Button that publishes the new post.

compose.submit.reply.description: Button that publishes the reply being written.

compose.text.label.description: Label of the text area where the user writes the text of a post.

compose.title.description: Heading of the form that writes a new post (the side panel on wide screens, the sheet on phones).

compose.visibility.button.description: Button that opens the choice of who can see the post. {visibility} is the current choice, for example 'Public'.

compose.visibility.direct.description: Visibility of a post: only the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.done.description: Button that closes the list of visibility choices.

compose.visibility.limited.defaultMessage: Posted with the visibility “{visibility}”: your account cannot post more widely right now.
compose.visibility.limited.description: Notice after posting when the server narrowed the chosen visibility because of a restriction on the account. {visibility} is the visibility the post got, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a post: signed-in people of this server and the author's followers. Not the same as 'local only' in other software: followers on other servers receive it.

compose.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: People signed in here, and your followers on other servers. Shown on this server's local timeline.

compose.visibility.private.description: Visibility of a post: the author's followers and the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Only your followers and the people you mention.

compose.visibility.public.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, and listed on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Anyone, here and on other servers. Shown on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.title.description: Label of the list of visibility choices for a post.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, but kept off the public timelines.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Anyone with the link, but not shown on the public timelines.

compose.warning.description.defaultMessage: Readers see this first and choose whether to show the post.
compose.warning.description.description: Help text under the content warning field.

compose.warning.label.description: Label of the field with the content warning text of a post.

compose.warning.toggle.description: Checkbox that adds a content warning: a short text shown instead of the post until the reader opens it.

home.title.description: Heading and document title of the home timeline page.

local.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the public posts of this server's accounts.

login.body.defaultMessage: Sign in to {instance} to post, follow people and read your home timeline.
login.body.description: Text on the sign-in page. {instance} is the name of this server.

login.failed.denied.defaultMessage: The sign-in was cancelled on the server's screen.
login.failed.denied.description: Why signing in failed: the user declined on the server's authorization screen.

login.failed.invalid_state.defaultMessage: This sign-in was not started in this tab, or it has already been completed. Start again.
login.failed.invalid_state.description: Why signing in failed: the answer from the server does not belong to a sign-in that this browser tab started.

login.failed.rejected.defaultMessage: The server did not accept the sign-in. Start again.
login.failed.rejected.description: Why signing in failed: the server refused to finish it (for example, it took too long).

login.failed.retry.description: Link from the failed sign-in page back to the sign-in page.

login.failed.title.description: Heading and document title of the page shown when signing in failed on the way back from the server's sign-in screen.

login.submit.description: Button on the sign-in page that opens the server's sign-in screen.

login.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that starts signing in.

notifications.empty.all.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when the user has no notifications.

notifications.empty.description.defaultMessage: When someone follows you, mentions you or reacts to your posts, it shows up here.
notifications.empty.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty notifications page.

notifications.empty.filtered.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when no notification matches the selected type filter.

notifications.filter.all.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows notifications of every type.

notifications.filter.boosts.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only boosts of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.favourites.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only favourites of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.follows.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only new followers, follow requests and accepted follow requests.

notifications.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tab list that filters the notifications by type.

notifications.filter.mentions.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only posts that mention the user.

notifications.load_more.description: Button at the end of the notifications that loads older ones.

notifications.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while notifications load.

notifications.post.open.description: Link in a notification that opens the post it is about.

notifications.post.show.description: Button that shows a post hidden behind its author's content warning, in a notification.

notifications.retry.description: Button that loads the notifications again after they failed to load.

notifications.sign_in.description: Link on the notifications page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

notifications.signed_out.defaultMessage: Sign in to see your notifications.
notifications.signed_out.description: Text on the notifications page when nobody is signed in.

notifications.time.description: When a notification happened: its date and time, for example 'Oct 16, 2026 9:41 AM'. {time} is that moment.

notifications.title.description: Heading and document title of the notifications page.

notifications.type.boost.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that boosted the user's post.

notifications.type.favourite.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that favourited the user's post.

notifications.type.follow.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the new follower.

notifications.type.follow_accepted.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that accepted the user's follow request.

notifications.type.follow_request.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that asked to follow the user.

notifications.type.mention.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the author of a post that mentions the user.

notifications.type.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: The moderators of this server sent you a notice
notifications.type.moderation_notice.description: Notification sentence: a notice to the user from the moderators of the server.

notifications.type.poll_closed.defaultMessage: A poll you took part in has ended
notifications.type.poll_closed.description: Notification sentence: a poll that the user created or voted in has closed.

notifications.unread.description: Read by screen readers before the sentence of a notification that was new when the page opened.

notifications.unread_count.description: The number of unread notifications on the badge of the navigation item, for example '3 unread'.

page.not_built.defaultMessage: This screen is not ready yet.
page.not_built.description: Text below the heading of a page whose screen the web client does not have yet.

profile.title.description: Heading and document title of the signed-in user's own profile page.

session.account.title.description: Heading of the section of the settings page about the signed-in account.

session.sign_in.description: Link in the account section of the settings page that opens the sign-in page.

session.sign_out.description: Button that signs the user out of the app in every tab.

session.sign_out.failed.defaultMessage: You are signed out here, but the server could not be reached. Your session may resume when you reload the page.
session.sign_out.failed.description: Notice after signing out when the server could not be told; the browser may still hold the session.

session.signed_out.description: Text in the account section of the settings page when nobody is signed in.

settings.back.description: Link under the heading of a settings page that opens the list of settings pages.

settings.blocks.empty.description: Shown when the user blocks no account.

settings.blocks.summary.defaultMessage: Accounts that cannot follow you or see your posts
settings.blocks.summary.description: Description of the blocked accounts page in the list of settings pages.

settings.blocks.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page with the blocked accounts.

settings.blocks.unblocked.description: Announced after an account was unblocked. {name} is the account's display name.

settings.default_visibility.description.defaultMessage: You can still choose for each post.
settings.default_visibility.description.description: Help text of the default visibility radio group.

settings.default_visibility.label.defaultMessage: Who sees your posts by default
settings.default_visibility.label.description: Label of the radio group of the visibility new posts start with.

settings.follow_requests.accept.description: Button that accepts a follow request.

settings.follow_requests.accepted.description: Announced after a follow request was accepted. {name} is the account's display name.

settings.follow_requests.empty.description: Shown when no follow request awaits approval.

settings.follow_requests.reject.description: Button that rejects a follow request.

settings.follow_requests.rejected.defaultMessage: You rejected the follow request of {name}.
settings.follow_requests.rejected.description: Announced after a follow request was rejected. {name} is the account's display name.

settings.follow_requests.summary.defaultMessage: People who asked to follow you
settings.follow_requests.summary.description: Description of the follow requests page in the list of settings pages.

settings.follow_requests.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page with the follow requests awaiting approval.

settings.list.action.description: Accessible name of a button in a list of accounts. {action} is the button's visible text (for example 'Unblock'), {name} the account's display name.

settings.list.more.description: Button under a list of accounts in the settings that loads more of them.

settings.locale.description.defaultMessage: The app switches to it at once.
settings.locale.description.description: Help text of the display language select.

settings.locale.label.description: Label of the select of the language the app is shown in.

settings.menu.title.description: Heading of the list of links to the pages of the settings.

settings.mutes.empty.description: Shown when the user mutes no account.

settings.mutes.notifications.description: Under a muted account whose mute also hides its notifications.

settings.mutes.summary.defaultMessage: Accounts whose posts you do not see
settings.mutes.summary.description: Description of the muted accounts page in the list of settings pages.

settings.mutes.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page with the muted accounts.

settings.mutes.unmuted.description: Announced after an account was unmuted. {name} is the account's display name.

settings.mutes.until.description: When a mute ends, under the muted account. {date} is a formatted date and time.

settings.preferences.autosave.defaultMessage: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
settings.preferences.autosave.description: Text at the top of the preferences page.

settings.preferences.summary.defaultMessage: Language, time zone, who sees your posts by default, and the languages of your timelines
settings.preferences.summary.description: Description of the preferences page in the list of settings pages.

settings.preferences.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page with the language, time zone, default visibility and timeline languages.

settings.profile.avatar.description: Heading of the part of the profile form for the user's profile picture.

settings.profile.bot.description: Checkbox of the profile form: the account is automated.

settings.profile.bot.description.defaultMessage: The account posts automatically, and others see that it may not be watched.
settings.profile.bot.description.description: Help text of the 'This is a bot' checkbox.

settings.profile.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
settings.profile.characters_left.description: Character count under the bio field while the text is within the limit.

settings.profile.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
settings.profile.characters_over.description: Character count under the bio field when the text is longer than the limit.

settings.profile.display_name.description: Label of the display name field of the profile form.

settings.profile.display_name.descriptio.defaultMessage: Up to {max} characters. Leave it empty to show your username.
settings.profile.display_name.descriptio.description: Help text of the display name field. {max} is the character limit, for example 30.

settings.profile.field.description: Caption of one field of the profile form. {number} is its position, starting at 1.

settings.profile.field.name.description: Label of the name part of a profile field.

settings.profile.field.name_required.description: Error of a profile field that has content but no label.

settings.profile.field.remove.description: Button that removes one field from the profile form. {number} is its position, starting at 1.

settings.profile.field.value.description: Label of the value part of a profile field.

settings.profile.fields.description: Heading of the part of the profile form with the label and content pairs shown on the profile.

settings.profile.fields.add.description: Button that adds an empty field to the profile form.

settings.profile.fields.description.defaultMessage: Up to {max} pairs of a label and content, shown on your profile. Links in the content work.
settings.profile.fields.description.description: Help text of the profile fields. {max} is how many fields a profile can have, for example 4.

settings.profile.header.description: Heading of the part of the profile form for the wide image at the top of the profile.

settings.profile.image.choose.description: Button that opens the file picker to choose a new avatar or header image.

settings.profile.image.failed.defaultMessage: The server could not process this image. Try another one.
settings.profile.image.failed.description: Error under an avatar or header image whose upload failed during processing.

settings.profile.image.remove.description: Button that removes the avatar or header image when the profile is saved.

settings.profile.locked.description: Checkbox of the profile form: follow requests need the user's approval.

settings.profile.locked.description.defaultMessage: People must ask to follow you, and you choose whom to accept.
settings.profile.locked.description.description: Help text of the 'Approve followers' checkbox.

settings.profile.note.description: Label of the profile text field of the profile form.

settings.profile.save.description: Submit button of the profile form.

settings.profile.saved.description: Notification after the profile was saved.

settings.profile.summary.defaultMessage: Your name, bio, pictures and fields, and who may follow you
settings.profile.summary.description: Description of the profile page in the list of settings pages.

settings.profile.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page that edits the user's profile.

settings.profile.too_long.description: Error of a profile field whose text is longer than its limit. {max} is the limit.

settings.saved.description: Announced to screen readers after a preference was saved; preferences save as soon as they change.

settings.time_zone.description.defaultMessage: Dates and times are shown in this time zone.
settings.time_zone.description.description: Help text of the time zone select.

settings.time_zone.label.description: Label of the select of the user's time zone.

settings.timeline_languages.description.defaultMessage: Timelines show posts in the languages you check. Check none to see every language.
settings.timeline_languages.description.description: Help text of the timeline languages.

settings.timeline_languages.label.description: Caption of the group of checkboxes of the languages timelines show.

settings.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page.

settings.visibility.direct.description: Visibility option: only the mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.direct.description.description: Description of the 'Mentioned people' visibility option.

settings.visibility.local.description: Visibility option: signed-in users of this server and followers.

settings.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: People signed in to this server, and your followers
settings.visibility.local.description.description: Description of the 'This server' visibility option.

settings.visibility.private.description: Visibility option: followers and mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Your followers and the people you mention

settings.visibility.public.description: Visibility option: everyone, listed on public timelines.

settings.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, and shown on public timelines

settings.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility option: everyone, but kept off public timelines.

settings.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, but kept off public timelines

shell.about.domain.description: In the side column about this server: the domain of the handles of local accounts, for example 'Accounts here end with @example.com.'.

shell.about.title.description: Heading of the side column, shown on wide screens, that tells about the server the user is on.

shell.document_title.description: The browser tab title: the heading of the current page, then the server's name.

shell.error.body.defaultMessage: This page could not be shown. Try again, or come back later.
shell.error.body.description: Text on the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.error.retry.description: Button that loads the failed page again.

shell.error.title.description: Heading of the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while a page loads.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation item that opens the home timeline. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation (the tab bar on phones, the side rail on larger screens).

shell.nav.local.description: Navigation item that opens the local timeline (posts of this server's accounts). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications_unread.defaultMessage: Notifications, {count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}}
shell.nav.notifications_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item that opens the notifications while some are unread. Start it with the text of shell.nav.notifications, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread notifications.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: There is no page at this address.
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.description: Link on the not-found page back to the home timeline.

shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: The server sent settings the app cannot read. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.

shell.update.apply.description: Button in the message about a new version of the app; pressing it reloads the page into the new version.

shell.update.available.defaultMessage: A new version of the app is available.
shell.update.available.description: Message shown when a new version of the web app has been downloaded and waits until the user applies it.

status.action.bookmark.description: Toggle button under a post that bookmarks it or removes the bookmark. Bookmarks are private. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.boost.description: Toggle button under a post that shares (boosts) it with the user's followers, or retracts the boost. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.copy_link.description: Menu item that copies the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.action.delete.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that asks to delete it.

status.action.failed.description: Toast when boosting, favouriting or bookmarking a post failed; the button is set back. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.action.favourite.description: Toggle button under a post that adds it to or removes it from the user's favourites. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.more.description: Button under a post that opens a menu with more actions on it, and the name of that menu.

status.action.reply.description: Button under a post that starts a reply to it.

status.bookmark.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed the bookmark of a post.

status.bookmark.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user bookmarked a post.

status.boost.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user retracted the boost of a post.

status.boost.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user boosted a post.

status.delete.cancel.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that keeps the post.

status.delete.confirm.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that deletes the post.

status.delete.description.defaultMessage: It will be removed for everyone, along with its boosts and favourites. You cannot undo this.
status.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.delete.done.description: Toast after the user's post was deleted.

status.delete.failed.description: Toast when deleting the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.delete.title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.favourite.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed a post from their favourites.

status.favourite.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user favourited a post.

status.link.copied.description: Toast after the address of a post was copied to the clipboard.

status.link.failed.description: Toast when the browser refused to copy the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.not_found.body.defaultMessage: This post does not exist, or you cannot see it.
status.not_found.body.description: Text under the heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.thread.ancestors.description: Heading above the posts that the post of the page replies to, oldest first.

status.thread.failed.description: Shown under the post of the page when its thread failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while the thread around a post loads.

status.thread.no_replies.description: Shown under the Replies heading when the post has no replies.

status.thread.replies.description: Heading above the replies to the post of the page.

status.thread.retry.description: Button that loads the thread around a post again after a failure.

status.title.description: Heading of the page of one post and the thread around it.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: Your posts and the posts of the people you follow appear here.
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of the people on this server appear here.
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: In the timeline, Page Down and Page Up move between posts.
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while posts of a timeline load.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Badge on a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text); screen readers read it as the picture's name.

timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.action.description: Link on the home page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: Sign in to read the posts of the people you follow.
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Text on the home page when nobody is signed in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.
